text: I want--oh, my dear, do you know how much I want to like the people you like? I want to see people as they are.” “Well, don't forget to see people as other folks see them as they are! They have the stuff. Did you know that Percy Bresnahan came from here? Born and brought up here!” “Bresnahan?” “Yes--you know--president of the Velvet Motor Company of Boston, Mass.--make the Velvet Twelve--biggest automobile factory in New England.” “I think I've heard of him.” “Sure you have.
